name: Assert
description: Run real Playwright E2E tests from your AI coding agent. Describe what to test in plain English, Assert writes and executes the test, and reports back step-by-step results.

ASSERT_API_KEY.description: Your Assert API key. Optional if your repo uses assert.config.json or assert.config.local.json.

ASSERT_CONFIG.description: Optional path to an Assert config file or project directory.
